package internalapi

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const practiceLearningActionBodyLimit = 32 << 10

func (h *Handler) ReservePracticeLearningAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.PracticeLearningActions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "practice learning actions are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve
	if err := decodePracticeLearningActionJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	request.StudentID, request.TaskInstanceID, request.IdempotencyKey = chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "taskInstanceID"), r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	result, err := h.PracticeLearningActions.Reserve(r.Context(), request)
	writePracticeLearningActionResult(w, result, err)
}

func (h *Handler) GetPracticeLearningAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.PracticeLearningActions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "practice learning actions are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.PracticeLearningActions.Get(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "taskInstanceID"))
	writePracticeLearningActionResult(w, result, err)
}

func (h *Handler) OpenPracticeLearningAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.PracticeLearningActions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "practice learning actions are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		Schema           string `json:"schema"`
		LearningActionID string `json:"learning_action_id"`
	}
	if err := decodePracticeLearningActionJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil || request.Schema != domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionOpenSchema {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.PracticeLearningActions.Open(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "taskInstanceID"), request.LearningActionID)
	writePracticeLearningActionResult(w, result, err)
}

func (h *Handler) CancelPracticeLearningAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.PracticeLearningActions == nil {
		http.Error(w, "practice learning actions are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		Schema           string `json:"schema"`
		LearningActionID string `json:"learning_action_id"`
		Reason           string `json:"reason"`
	}
	if err := decodePracticeLearningActionJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil || request.Schema != domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionCancelSchema || !domain.IsPracticeLearningActionCancelReason(request.Reason) {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.PracticeLearningActions.Cancel(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "taskInstanceID"), request.LearningActionID, request.Reason)
	writePracticeLearningActionResult(w, result, err)
}

func (h *Handler) ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.PracticeLearningEvidence == nil {
		http.Error(w, "practice learning evidence is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2
	if err := decodePracticeLearningActionJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	receipt, err := h.PracticeLearningEvidence.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "taskInstanceID"), r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), request)
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrEvidenceContract), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid practice learning evidence", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			http.Error(w, "practice learning action not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStatus):
			http.Error(w, "practice learning evidence conflict", http.StatusConflict)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "practice learning evidence failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(receipt)
}

func decodePracticeLearningActionJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, practiceLearningActionBodyLimit))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("invalid trailing request data")
	}
	return nil
}

func writePracticeLearningActionResult(w http.ResponseWriter, result domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid practice learning action", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			http.Error(w, "practice learning action not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStatus):
			http.Error(w, "practice learning action conflict", http.StatusConflict)
		default:
			http.Error(w, "practice learning action failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}
